```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(DiffBind)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
Samples<-dba(sampleSheet = "DiffBindSample.csv")
Samples<-dba.count(Samples)
Samples
```

```{r}
info<-dba.show(Samples)
libsizes<-cbind(LibReads=info$Reads, FRiP=info$FRiP, PeakReads=round(info$Reads*info$FRiP))
rownames(libsizes)<-info$ID
libsizes
```


```{r}
Samples<-dba.normalize(Samples,normalize=DBA_NORM_LIB)
norm<-dba.normalize(Samples, bRetrieve=T)
```


```{r}
Samples<-dba.contrast(Samples, minMembers = 2, contrast = c("Treatment", "MPEC_Runx3", "MPEC_Ctrl"))
Samples<-dba.analyze(Samples)
dba.show(Samples, bContrasts = T)
MPEC<-dba.report(Samples, contrast = 1, fold=1, bDB = T)
MPEC<-as.data.frame(MPEC$peaks)
write.table(MPEC[,c(1:3)], file="MPEC_DiffPeaks.bed", quote = F, sep="\t", row.names = F, col.names = F)
#Quantify Differential Binding Sites
sum(MPEC$Fold>0)
sum(MPEC$Fold<0)
```


```{r}
#Extract non-significant peaks
MPEC_notDB<-dba.report(Samples, contrast = 1, fold=1, bNotDB = T)
MPEC_notDB<-as.data.frame(MPEC_notDB$peaks)
MPEC_All<-rbind(MPEC, MPEC_notDB)
write.table(MPEC_All[,c(1:3)], file="AllMPECPeaks.bed", quote = F, sep="\t", row.names = F, col.names = F)
#Shift start to align with position file from annotation
MPEC_All$Start<-as.integer(MPEC_All$Start+1)
```

```{bash, eval=F}
#Annotate positions with gene names with Homer
bed2pos.pl AllMPECPeaks.bed > AllMPECPeaks.txt
annotatePeaks.pl AllMPECPeaks.txt mm39 > AllMPECPeaks.annotated.txt
```


```{r}
AnnotateAllMPEC<-read.csv(file="AllMPECPeaks.annotated.txt", sep = "\t")
AnnotateAllMPEC_FC<-merge(MPEC_All, AnnotateAllMPEC, by=c("Chr", "Start", "End"), all.x=T)
write.table(AnnotateAllMPEC_FC, file="AllMPECPeaks_Annotated.txt", sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = F)

library(dplyr)
#Only keep the gene name for the most significant peak for auto labeling
AnnotateAllMPEC_FC<- AnnotateAllMPEC_FC%>%
  group_by(Gene.Name) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_Filt = if_else(row_number() == which.min(FDR),
                       Gene.Name,
                       "NotSignificant")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

library(EnhancedVolcano)
pdf("VolcanoPlots.pdf", paper = "USr", height=10, width=6.1)
  EnhancedVolcano(AnnotateAllMPEC_FC,
    lab = AnnotateAllMPEC_FC$Gene_Filt,
    x = 'Fold',pCutoff = 0.05, col=c("grey", "lightblue", "grey", "red"),
    y = 'FDR', pointSize = 3, title="MPEC Runx3 vs Ctrl",
    selectLab=c("Pdcd1", "Itgae", "Irf8", "Cd101", "Bcl11b", "Btg1", "Btg2", "Btg3", "Ets1", "Bach2", "Ahr", "Tgfbr1", "Smad3", "Litaf", "Nfil3"),
    drawConnectors = T, widthConnectors = 0.75, maxoverlapsConnectors = Inf)

dev.off()
```
